cc:Work.dc:description: Single H200; synthetic W1664 / D27 / T2048 / head10; 2 ABBA pairs per workload; 20 warmup steps per trial. All 40 samples per trial; bars mark medians. No filtering, confidence intervals, or automatic performance claim. No native independent real forward/backward qualification. Within each trial, points run left to right from sample 1 to 40.
